name: ow-tools
description: Runs code on your machine. The Claude Code add-on for the ow- planning skills: local call transcription with speaker separation (ffmpeg, whisper.cpp, pyannote), branded and accessible PDF and Word export (pandoc, Typst), date and arithmetic checks, and a session-start list of open workstreams. Audio never leaves the machine. Needs Node 20+ and the tools /ow-tools lists; it installs nothing itself.
